The balance this toner brings to my face is unbeatable. I've tried other products and this one keeps my face the clearest

Shortly after applying I broke out in red spots that burned across my cheeks and the spots stuck around for a couple hours. After a few times of this happening I looked up the ingredients and there are many controversial and harmful ingredients in this product. I ended up throwing it out which is annoying because it was expensive.

avis.titre: It's just Ok to me. Smells like windex though.
avis.texte: First I think its important to disclose your age and skin type as your skin changes at different stages in life. I'm 39, and have dry skin. I picked this up along with several other dermalogica products and have been using them for 4 months. I wanted to use it for a while before reviewing. I wanted just a daily toner and picked this up to try out. I am not a fan of the spray component, its a little aggressive. Would much rather prefer a fine mist instead. It smells a bit like windex to me. I don't see a noticable difference after using this. So the value for the cost is not worth it to me. It's just an average toner.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling like sandpaper
avis.texte: I normally love Dermalogica products. I've tried this toner several times and it feels nice the first day I use it. The next day my skin feels like sandpaper and is extremely dry. I made the mistake of buying a large bottle before trying it out… I've let my skin calm down and tried it again but the result is always the same. I threw it out this time. It's been 3 days and my skin is very uncomfortable and itchy.
Very refreshing and moisturizing. Just terrific. Will definitely purchase again.

At first, my skin felt like it was getting burnt when i started using it but after my skin got used to it, the burning went away and now it feels more refreshed and i love that. Definitely using this toner from now on.

The purchase before this came out in a mist , but with this purchase the nozzle was different and came out in a stream.

I guess its the same "burning" feeling people said they hated but I personally like it. Instead of burning it felt kind of like putting something foamy on your face and feeling the bubbles. Didn't improve my skins texture but it does feel more hydrated. It doesn't seem worth it to buy the full size version but I would buy the mini again during a BOGO.
